title: Polynomial biased probability of a negative output
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$, and let $p\in\mathbb R$. The polynomial biased minus probability of $f$ at $p$ is $(1-E_f(m(p)))/2$, where $E_f$ is the biased expectation polynomial associated with the real-valued version of $f$, and $m(p)$ is the bias mean corresponding to $p$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps sign vectors of length $n$ to signs
caveat: The supplied statement omits the definitions and parameter convention for the biased expectation polynomial and bias mean.
